scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.self-hosted.yml up -d minio minio-init mysql redis temporal-create-namespace
scripts.dev:cloud: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && npm run env:cloud:check:dev && npm run runtime:sms:smoke && cross-env WAO_DEV_ENV_FILE=.env.cloud.local sh scripts/dev-docker.sh
scripts.dev:cloud:rebuild: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && npm run env:cloud:check:dev && npm run runtime:sms:smoke && cross-env WAO_DEV_ENV_FILE=.env.cloud.local WAO_DEV_FORCE_REBUILD=1 sh scripts/dev-docker.sh
scripts.dev:next: npm run edition:prepare && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation" next dev --turbopack -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.dev:temporal-worker: npm run edition:prepare && tsx watch --tsconfig .generated/edition/tsconfig.json --env-file=.env src/lib/temporal/worker.ts
scripts.build: npm run edition:prepare && prisma generate && next build --turbopack && node scripts/check-next-build-artifacts.mjs
scripts.build:verify:cloud: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && npm run env:cloud:check:dev && cross-env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-verify node scripts/run-with-env.mjs .env.cloud.local -- npm run build && npm run runtime:sms:smoke
scripts.start: npm run storage:init && concurrently --kill-others "npm run start:next" "npm run start:temporal-worker"
scripts.env:cloud:check: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud npm run edition:prepare && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud node ee/scripts/check-cloud-env.mjs .env.cloud.local --mode=production
scripts.env:cloud:check:dev: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud npm run edition:prepare && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud node ee/scripts/check-cloud-env.mjs .env.cloud.local --mode=development
scripts.runtime:self-hosted:smoke: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MODE=user-key BILLING_MODE=OFF npm run edition:prepare && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MODE=user-key BILLING_MODE=OFF tsx --tsconfig .generated/edition/tsconfig.json scripts/edition/self-hosted-runtime-smoke.ts
scripts.runtime:cloud:smoke: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs .env.cloud.local -- npm run runtime:cloud:smoke:loaded
scripts.runtime:cloud:smoke:loaded: npm run edition:prepare && tsx --tsconfig .generated/edition/tsconfig.json ee/scripts/cloud-runtime-smoke.ts && tsx --tsconfig .generated/edition/tsconfig.json ee/scripts/aliyun-sms-sdk-smoke.ts
scripts.runtime:sms:smoke: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud npm run edition:prepare && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud tsx --tsconfig .generated/edition/tsconfig.json ee/scripts/aliyun-sms-sdk-smoke.ts
scripts.check:pricing-catalog:core: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted npm run edition:prepare && tsx --tsconfig .generated/edition/tsconfig.runtime-scripts.json scripts/check-pricing-catalog.ts
scripts.check:pricing-catalog:ee: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud npm run edition:prepare && tsx --tsconfig .generated/edition/tsconfig.runtime-scripts.json scripts/check-pricing-catalog.ts
scripts.test:security: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted npm run edition:prepare && cross-env BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=0 playwright test --config tests/browser-security/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:editions: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud npm run typecheck && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted npm run typecheck
scripts.verify:commit: echo "verify:commit skipped; pre-commit only scans staged secrets, while pre-push owns bounded local verification."
scripts.verify:push:local: npm run verify:push && npm run test:conformance
scripts.test:logic:core: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted BILLING_MODE=OFF BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=0 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite logic-core --root tests/unit
scripts.test:logic:ee: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud BILLING_MODE=ENFORCE BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=0 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite logic-ee --root ee/tests/unit
scripts.test:conformance:core: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted BILLING_MODE=OFF BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=0 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite conformance-core --root tests/contracts
scripts.test:conformance:ee: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud BILLING_MODE=ENFORCE BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=0 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite conformance-ee --root tests/contracts
scripts.test:critical:provider:core: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=0 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite critical-provider-core --root tests/integration/provider
scripts.test:critical:provider:ee: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs ee/.env.example -- cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=0 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite critical-provider-ee --root ee/tests/integration/provider
scripts.test:critical:temporal: cross-env BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 TEMPORAL_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite critical-temporal --root tests/integration/temporal
scripts.test:critical:billing:core: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted BILLING_MODE=OFF BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite critical-billing-core --root tests/integration/billing
scripts.test:critical:billing:ee: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud BILLING_MODE=ENFORCE BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite critical-billing-ee --root ee/tests/integration/billing
scripts.test:critical:billing-concurrency:core: cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=self-hosted BILLING_MODE=OFF BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite critical-billing-concurrency-core --root tests/concurrency/billing
scripts.test:critical:billing-concurrency:ee: npm run edition:deps:check:cloud && cross-env DEPLOYMENT_EDITION=cloud BILLING_MODE=ENFORCE BILLING_TEST_BOOTSTRAP=1 node scripts/test-verification/run-required-suite.mjs --suite critical-billing-concurrency-ee --root ee/tests/concurrency/billing
scripts.test:critical: npm run test:critical:provider && npm run test:critical:task && npm run test:critical:temporal && npm run test:critical:billing && npm run test:critical:billing-concurrency && npm run test:critical:security
